    -> Let me explain how to read weapon parameters.{WAIT}{PAGE}- Gender ♂ means for men, ♀ for women. The other gender can't equip it.{WAIT}{PAGE}- Alignment L is LAW, C is CHAOS, N is NEUTRAL. Only people of that alignment can equip it.{WAIT}{PAGE}ALL means anyone can equip it, whatever their alignment.{WAIT}{PAGE}- Attack Shows how much damage it deals. It isn't the exact damage amount, mind you.{WAIT}{PAGE}- Accuracy The weapon's hit rating.
